QuestInfo.name: Chris's Request
QuestInfo.parent: Nella & Kerning City Citizen's Other Request
QuestInfo.1: I got another request from #p406#. #p415#'s pillow was stolen a few days ago, and now he just can't get to sleep. To make a new pillow, he needs #b20 #t4003002#s#k and #b20 pieces of #t4000049##k. I should get them as soon as possible, so Chris can get some sleep!
QuestInfo.2: I delivered what #p415# asked for and got some refined iron and bronze in return. #p415# can finally sleep well with his new pillow. Return to #p406# for another gig.

0.0: Oh, thanks for coming! I just got a new request for you. It seems like #b#p415##k from the hardware store is having trouble sleeping these days. Apparently, someone stole his pillow... Now who in their right mind would steal a pillow? Geez.
0.1: In any case, we need to make a new pillow, but it's not that easy to get the required materials. Can you get #b20 #t4003002#s#k and #b20 pieces of #t4000049#s#k? That shouldn't be too difficult. Come see me after you have collected everything.

1.0: Great work. It is a pleasure working with you, you know that? All right, let's talk rewards. #b#p415##k is giving you #b1 #t4010100##k and #b1 #t4010101##k.

yes.0: All right, if you need work sometime down the road, feel free to come back and see me.

item.0: I see you still haven't gathered the materials that #b#p415##k requested. You need #b20 #t4003002#s#k and #b20 #t4000049#s#k in order to create a new pillow. Just bring everything to me. Good luck!
